verdict.rationale: Vapi's tools documentation lists transferring the call as a built-in assistant action, so the product itself can hand a live call off. Nothing in the pack describes warm versus blind transfer modes, transferring to a human agent specifically, or passing call context or a summary to the recipient. missing for 10: documented warm transfer mode, documented blind transfer mode, context/summary handoff to the human, transfer configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along

citations.quote: transfer the call, look up a customer record, book an appointment, or end the call
